threads.body: [General] Catch and log telemetry failures inside this callback. Dubbo 2.7.5's `whenCompleteWithContext` replaces its response future with the callback's dependent stage and restores `RpcContext` only after the callback returns. If `instrumenter.end` throws, for example from a custom `AttributesExtractor.onEnd`, a successful RPC becomes exceptional and context restoration is skipped. The catch around `MethodHandle.invoke` cannot intercept exceptions captured by that stage. Keep telemetry failures from escaping the callback, and add a regression test with a throwing extractor.

replies.body:
Addressed in a631e64e3399b0ed780edc6cbbf5dc1bbceb7edb.

Verified Dubbo 2.7.5 whenCompleteWithContext replaces responseFuture with its dependent stage and calls context restoration after the callback without finally. Provider completion now catches and logs telemetry failures inside the callback. A throwing onEnd extractor regression verifies the successful response, restoration of both completion-thread RpcContext instances, and one end invocation. The regression passed with the guard and failed with CompletionException caused by telemetry failure when the guard was removed.

threads.body: [General] Dubbo 2.7.2's `AsyncRpcResult` extends `CompletableFuture<Result>` through `AbstractResult`, but exposes neither of the completion methods detected above. Both handles are null, so this returns false and the provider span ends before a delayed result completes, losing its full duration and terminal failure. Add a `CompletionStage` fallback and exercise the shared delayed-provider test against 2.7.2 as well as 2.7.0.

Added a CompletionStage fallback and a pinned agent-backed 2.7.2 suite alongside 2.7.0, with delayed success/failure assertions in legacy, preview, and duplicate RPC semconv modes. All modes passed; removing the fallback made both 2.7.2 delayed cases fail.
